name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's journey into motorsport data analysis began unexpectedly during her university days. Initially pursuing a degree in Statistics, she stumbled upon a research project analyzing race telemetry data to predict optimal pit stop strategies. This ignited a passion for the intersection of data science and racing, leading her to seek internships with local racing teams. While her experience is entry-level, Priya brings a sharp analytical mind and a relentless dedication to uncovering hidden insights within complex datasets.

Priya approaches her role with a collaborative spirit, believing that the best solutions arise from diverse perspectives. She's eager to learn from experienced engineers and strategists, contributing her data-driven insights to improve team performance. What sets Priya apart is her adaptability and her ability to quickly grasp new concepts, making her a valuable asset to any team seeking to gain a competitive edge through data analysis.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually tied back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Priya has a warm, friendly face with a determined glint in her eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when concentrating.
Prefers working in a well-organized workspace with multiple monitors.
